VERDICT: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | ESCALATE     # worst member verdict: BLOCKED > ESCALATE > FAIL > PASS
DIGEST:
  headline: example
  team: example                               # ONE KEY PER LINE — three on one line is not YAML,
  steps_run: 1                             # and the two trailing ones vanish silently
  cycles_used: 1
  members:                                   # per-member roll-up — NOT optional
    - { step: s1, persona: backend-dev, verdict: PASS, headline: "example", files_touched: [] }
    - { step: should-not-exist, persona: fable-advisor, status: skipped, reason: "example" } # only optional external member
  must_fix: []
  files_touched: []    # universal — required of you too; [] if none
  branch: none                    # `none` if the team mutated no repo
  open_questions: []                      # non-empty → the orchestrator surfaces it to the
                                             # MAIN SESSION, the only tier that can ask the user
  escalations: []
  expertise_update: []                  # [] except on a distillation dispatch
  adequacy_notes: []     # [] when nothing; required, NEVER omitted
  # Optional passthroughs from a member roll-up: sc_status, needs_approval, severity_max, matrix_ok, coverage_gaps, findings (each with kind), readers (plan: ran | skipped). Any other field is rejected; put qualifications in adequacy_notes or run-state evidence.
artifact: r/digest.md                # your collated report — NOT state.yaml
